To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the effective gauge structure is universal in the low-energy effective theory of supersymmetric confining gauge theories, and that the composite « matter multiplets » are arranged in a generationlike structure under this effective gauge structure.

(1) the low-energy effective Lagrangian of a supersymmetric confining theory contains a universal structure of effective gauge symmetry; (2) this effective gauge symmetry acts on the low-energy composite matter fields in a way that is reminiscent of the way the standard model gauge symmetry acts on its matter fields; and (3) this structure of effective gauge symmetries and their associated low-energy composite matter multiplets is reminiscent of the generation structure of the standard model
